algorithm_justification: Compared Random Forest (explainability for Mariana/Finance) vs XGBoost (precision for Felipe/Lucía purchasing). Selected by lowest test RMSE with fixed random_state=42. Winner: **xgboost**.

metric_notes.mse: Mean squared error in USD² — penalizes large misses; translate via RMSE/MAPE for Felipe/Mariana.
metric_notes.psi: Population Stability Index train→test — high PSI ⇒ structural shift (growth/new sites); retrain.
metric_notes.gini: Ranking quality of good vs bad months — low Gini ⇒ Mariana cannot spot weak months early.
metric_notes.k2: K2 Score ≡ R² — share of revenue variance explained on the test window.
